The **Center for Reservoir and Aquatic Systems Research (CRASR)** at Baylor University studies reservoirs, streams, and the watersheds that feed them.

This site covers the data side of that work: the software we use to collect, check, store, and model monitoring data, and the tools we share with other researchers.

## Working with us

We collaborate on monitoring design, data management, and statistical modeling for aquatic systems. Some of our code is public on [GitHub](https://github.com/CRASR). Much of our day-to-day tooling is private. If you're interested in a collaboration, a dataset, or a tool listed here that isn't public yet, get in touch.
